evidencePolicy.principle: Color meaning is relational and context-dependent. Theme names describe composition intent, not universal emotional effects.
requirements: text and consequential state must not rely on color alone
contrast must be tested in rendered context
CVD survivability is required when hue distinguishes categories or states
cultural and domain associations require explicit evidence before being treated as meaning

families.name: Neutral editorial
families.palette: light neutral surfaces, dark text, restrained accent
families.perceptualIntent: reduces chromatic competition so typography and structure carry hierarchy
families.meaningCaveat: Do not infer user emotion, credibility, safety, or trust from palette alone.
requiredChecks: CVD screening when hue carries category/state
evidence: Visual Engineering Itten color contrasts
Project Atlas color vocabulary and mechanism taxonomy
Project Atlas perceptual color genome
Perceptual Envelope EX-VE-COL-006 CVD minimax palette and semantic survivability
